description: Triggers a Puppet agent run restricted to a comma-separated list of tags, with optional extra agent flags. A single Ruby implementation runs on Linux, macOS and Windows via the Puppet agent's Ruby.

tags.description: Comma separated list of tags with no spaces, eg 'profile::ntp,profile::ssh'. Mandatory.

flags.description: Optional list of additional puppet agent flags, eg ['--noop', '--debug']. Replaces the legacy param1/param2 parameters.
